data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year development amounted to GBP 3.155m (adverse / strengthening), representing approximately 2.9% of opening gross claims outstanding. This movement was derived from the syndicate's gross claims development table (increase mainly on the 2018 underwriting year partly offset by a small release on 2017) and is consistent with the report's commentary that adverse claims experience was driven by natural catastrophe activity and COVID-19 related losses.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse claims experience, particularly from natural catastrophes and the losses arising from the Covid-19 pandemic.
This Unexpired risk provision relates to COVID-19 losses.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not explicitly provided as a single gross GROSS movement figure in the narrative or a 'movement in prior years' note. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development table (Claims development tables) as described in the report. No explicit verbatim sentence quantifying gross prior-year movement was found, so exact_reserve_text is empty. Triangle is in GBP '000 and was used to compute gross PYD for underwriting years 2018. No LOB-level PYD amounts were provided.
